title: Hold-Out Timing by Days Since a Wayfare Rides Payment Failure
content:
When a rider pays an unpaid fare on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**, the hold-out timing factor counts the calendar days from the date the payment failure was booked to today.

**Scale.** At most the prompt payment days of 7 take the prompt hold-out timing factor of 1.0; more than 7 days but at most the mid payment days of 14 take the mid hold-out timing factor of 0.75; a later payment leaves the factor unchanged.

| Days from the payment failure date to today | Hold-out timing factor |
|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | 1.0 |
| 8 to 14 | 0.75 |
| more than 14 | not changed |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical; payment failure booked on 1 August)

| Today | Days | Factor |
|---|---|---|
| 8 August | 7 | 1.0 |
| 9 August | 8 | 0.75 |
| 15 August | 14 | 0.75 |
| 16 August | 15 | not changed |

Day 7 and day 14 each fall in the band that ends on them: 7 days is still prompt, and 14 days still takes 0.75.
